description: CV-mode benchmark (Phase 4b). Hand-written questions about Chrystian, the same in English and Spanish. 'answer' is a short span to look for in the generated answer (per language when it differs); 'evidence' is the exact text of data/raw/cv/autobiography.md that answers it (Spanish questions) and 'evidence_en' that of data/raw/cv/autobiography_en.md (English questions) (the ground-truth source, located by src/sources/cv.py). 'ood' are questions about him the documents do not answer (expected: the CV 'not found' message) and contact data that must never be shown (phone, old e-mail).
